image_description: The image displays a disassembled bassoon laid out on the floor against a white wall. The main components visible are the boot (bottom U-shaped joint), the long wing joint, and the bell joint standing vertically. A black carrying case or bag hangs on the wall above. The wood is a dark reddish-brown polished finish with silver metal keys. The instrument parts are resting on a wooden stand or directly on the floor.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The top of the left wooden segment appears to melt or fuse into a non-geometric shape. It lacks the clean tenon connection point expected for a bassoon wing joint. It looks like a distorted stump rather than a precise mechanical interface.
The white logo/symbol on the black bag is indistinct and slightly warped, lacking sharp edges typical of printed logos. It resembles AI-generated gibberish text/symbols.
The shadow cast by the instrument parts is inconsistent. Some parts have hard shadows, while others seem to float slightly without clear contact shadows, suggesting minor grounding issues.
